logp.method_description: The log Po/w of these complexes was calculated via shake flask method using the previously published procedure.4 A known amount of each complex was suspended in water (presaturated with n-octanol) and shaken for 48 h on an orbital shaker.5 To allow the phase separation, the solution was centrifuged for 10 min at 3000 rpm. After the separation of two layers, they were subjected to UV-Vis spectroscopic analysis. The partition coefficient (log Po/w) values were calculated using the OD of the complex in water and octanol.
